description: Complete ordinary field-linear automorphism-orbit classification for elements of the four-dimensional null-filiform Zinbiel algebra over every finite field.
integrity: Proof by explicit generator substitution and complete normal forms; direct finite-field computations are corroborating evidence, not substitutes for an all-field proof. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the stated four-dimensional algebra, finite fields and k-linear automorphisms are covered. No algebra isomorphism census, semilinear action, orbit-scheme structure, or higher-dimensional assertion is made. A related 2025 paper about local and 2-local automorphisms could not be inspected in full; literature coverage is not claimed exhaustive.
title: Characteristic-dependent automorphism orbits in the four-dimensional null-filiform Zinbiel algebra
